name: Development task (English)
description: Record the task's requirements, acceptance checklist (including verification methods and results), and completion status.

attributes.label: Requirements
attributes.placeholder: Describe the problem, the outcomes to achieve in this task, and any necessary constraints or scope boundaries.

attributes.label: Acceptance checklist
attributes.description: Replace the examples with verifiable outcomes, using a Markdown checkbox and a verification method for each item; shared methods may be described once in this section. After execution, add actual results or evidence links under the corresponding item. Check it off only when evidence confirms the criterion is met. For incomplete items, note checks not run, failures or blockers as needed; leave no example placeholders.
attributes.value:
- [ ] Verifiable outcome one
  Verification: describe the inspection method or command and expected result.

- [ ] Verifiable outcome two
  Verification: describe the inspection method or command and expected result.

attributes.label: Completion confirmation
attributes.value: - [ ] All requirements of this task have passed acceptance, and delivery is complete under the selected mode.

attributes.label: GIDD configuration
attributes.description: Set the delivery mode and target branch; merge modes also need a new development branch, while direct commit uses null. Keep the gidd code block.
